deployments_detail.use: CEO AI agent + ChatGPT Enterprise (Oct 2025, 500 custom GPTs in 3 months, 150 AI leaders); RAG for building management

'社長AIエージェント' (CEO AI Agent) — a proprietary AI agent developed in-house that reflects the president's strategic perspective/thinking, rolled out for company-wide trial use for employees to 'spar' ideas against management thinking. [Mitsui Fudosan in-house (on ChatGPT Enterprise / Azure)]

'OPTiM AI Camera for Office Building' deployed in Mitsui Fudosan office buildings to visualize user counts and congestion via camera image analysis on an NVIDIA GPU deep-learning platform (integrated with support from Macnica); image-analysis system built in ~2 months. [OPTiM; NVIDIA GPU; Macnica]

'Rehouse AI Assessment' — AI system jointly developed with ExaWizards for Mitsui Fudosan Realty that instantly calculates estimated contract prices for individually owned condominiums using AI, presenting appraisal estimates to customers. [ExaWizards + Mitsui Fudosan Realty]

'YOMEL' automatic meeting-minutes AI deployed at Mitsui Fudosan Realty to auto-generate minutes and cut post-negotiation data-entry work, reducing minutes-creation work by ~50% to free up sales staff for core selling activities. [PKSHA group (YOMEL)]

Deployed OpenAI ChatGPT Enterprise company-wide to all ~2,000 employees from Oct 1, 2025 for summarization, translation, document/email drafting and code generation; targeting 10%+ reduction in work time. Built on Microsoft Azure infrastructure with 150 AI Promotion Leaders across 85 divisions. [OpenAI (ChatGPT Enterprise); Microsoft Azure]

Custom GPTs / no-code internal assistant tools built by employees on the ChatGPT Enterprise platform; ~500 operational instances as of Dec 23, 2025 used across departments for task-specific assistance. [OpenAI (Custom GPT)]

'本部長AI / DX本部長AIエージェント' — an AI agent reproducing the DX division head's persona, thinking and division plans; operational in the DX division since Oct 2025 with six modes (advisory, document review, etc.), reducing document revision time ~30%. [Mitsui Fudosan in-house]

'&Chat (アンドチャット)' — proprietary company-specific generative-AI chat tool developed in-house and rolled out to all ~2,500 employees from Aug 2023 for internal document/knowledge tasks; Mitsui Fudosan's first company-wide generative AI deployment. [Mitsui Fudosan in-house (generative AI)]

RAG-based inquiry-handling AI deployed at Mitsui Fudosan Building Management to answer building-management inquiries across the group; projected to cut ~4,080 hours of inquiry handling annually, winning the company president's award. [PKSHA Technology (PKSHA RAG)]

'対話型スライド生成AI' (interactive slide-generation AI) developed jointly with ENIAQ and deployed company-wide; generates PowerPoint (.pptx) from text/PDF and refines via natural-language dialogue, saving an average of 44 minutes per document. [ENIAQ Inc. (University of Tokyo startup) + Mitsui Fudosan]

'PKSHA AI ヘルプデスク' AI-agent helpdesk introduced at Mitsui Fudosan Realty to handle internal inquiries; FAQ instant answers plus document-reading generative responses, streamlining ~3,000 internal inquiries per month; verification started for expanding to more departments. [PKSHA Technology (PKSHA AI Helpdesk)]
